machines.levelSubtitle: If you can rally a few balls, you'll get a lot out of it. It suits beginners up to about NTRP 4.5.
machines.levelBeginnerBody: Slow, consistent feeds to the same spot to groove your forehand and backhand. Start at low speed and raise it as you go.
machines.levelIntermediateBody: Mix topspin and slice, move side to side and drill transitions to the net with custom sequences.
machines.levelAdvancedBody: Up to 100 km/h, heavy spin, random patterns and a ball every 1.5 s — plus AI feedback on your technique.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Everything you need to know about delivery, the deposit, rain and more.
how.deliveryBody: Grab the machine at our downtown spot for free, or book our trips: we drop it off between 8 AM and 9 PM at any public court or address, and/or collect it when you're done. One trip from {trip}, round trip from {round} — priced by distance from downtown.
how.returnBody: Return it to our downtown spot at the end of your rental, or book collection and we'll come to you. Please have it powered off, with the balls back in the bucket — we check the machine and battery together.
how.depositBody: Your rental is charged when you book. The deposit is separate: a temporary hold on your card for short rentals, or a saved card for week and month rentals. It's released as soon as the machine is back in good condition.
how.rainBody: This is Victoria — we get it. If it rains on the day your rental starts, tap “Rained out?” in My bookings before your start time: reschedule for free, or take a 100% credit for your next booking.
how.cancelBody: Cancel 48 hours or more before your start time for a full refund. Inside 48 hours you get 50% back. You can cancel or reschedule anytime from “My bookings”.
how.ballsBody: Use pressureless tennis balls — they keep the same bounce for months and feed consistently. Pressurized balls go flat and can jam the feeder. Our ball bucket add-on includes 100–120 pressureless balls.
how.zoneBody: Trips are priced by straight-line distance from downtown Victoria (the rings on the map). Pins are the public courts we serve — or use your own address.

account.a: No. Book with your email or phone number. To see or change your bookings later, open “My bookings” and sign in with a one-time code we send you.

where.a: Wherever you like — at home, at your club or at a public court. Just respect the rules of the place: court time limits, municipal court bookings and whether ball machines are allowed.

delivery.a: Collect and return it at our downtown spot for free, or book our trips: we drop it off and/or collect it at your address, or in the parking lot or at the curb next to a court you choose — never inside the court. Trips are priced by distance from downtown: from {trip} one way or {round} round trip.

balls.a: Yes. Every rental comes with a full bucket of 100–120 pressureless balls. Want more? Add an extra bucket at checkout.

easy.q: Is the machine hard to use?
easy.a: Not at all. We show you everything in five minutes at hand-off. You control it from the PONGBOT app or just by talking to it (“more topspin”, “wider angle”), and you get a quick-start card and video.

ai.q: What does the AI camera do?
ai.a: The Spotter camera films you at 120 frames per second, tracks you and the ball, analyses your swing and movement and gives you voice tips while you play — plus a movement heatmap afterwards. You can also put it next to the net so it acts as an umpire and keeps score in matches with friends.

speed.q: How fast does it go? Is it good for my level?
speed.a: Up to 100 km/h (about 62 mph) in tennis, lobs up to 8 m high, topspin, slice and flat, and up to one ball every 1.5 seconds. It suits beginners through advanced players (up to about NTRP 4.5). Real-world speed varies with spin and settings.

pickleball.q: Can I use it for pickleball?
pickleball.a: Yes — the Aura S is set up for pickleball as well as tennis. Mention it in your booking notes and we'll bring it ready to go.

deposit.a: For rentals up to 6 days we place a temporary hold of {short} on your card — it's not a charge, and it's released as soon as the machine is back in good shape. For week and month rentals we securely save your card for up to {long} instead. We only charge it if the machine is damaged, lost or returned late, and we always explain why.

care.a: Optional damage protection you can add at checkout (from {price}). With Care, the most you pay for accidental damage is {cap}. It isn't insurance and doesn't cover theft, loss, use in the rain or gross negligence.

rain.a: Victoria, we know. If it rains on the day your rental starts, open My bookings before your start time and tap “Rained out?”: reschedule for free, or take a credit for 100% of what you paid, valid {months} months and applied automatically to your next booking. On days we declare a rain day, we email you the same options.

breaks.q: What if something breaks or jams?
breaks.a: Stop the machine, switch it off and contact us right away — don't open it. Most jams are a wet or damaged ball: switch off, take it out of the hopper and try again. Normal wear is on us.

friends.a: Absolutely. Each friend can connect their phone to the machine with the PONGBOT app and take turns. The person who rented is responsible for everyone who uses it.

cancel.a: Yes, from “My bookings”. Cancel more than 48 hours before the start for a full refund, or within 48 hours for 50% back. Rescheduling is free when the new time is available.

insured.a: Yes. RallyDrop carries commercial general liability insurance.
